Speaking in The Hague, Netherlands, Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlights the growing business opportunities between India and Europe. He says trade agreements with the European Union, EFTA and the UK can open new markets, boost investment and technology partnerships, and help Indian businesses expand their global reach.
